verdicts.decision_note: The client designates https://shatterhouse.example as the master-site domain, establishing the required public domain-to-site configuration.
The client changes the designated main-website domain to https://shatterhouseusa.example; updating the existing domain key leaves no stale attribute requiring removal.
First concrete failure: in the domain-reassignment exchange, the client reports being unable to switch the domain to the correct website.
First concrete post-failure verification: the client confirms that the domain connects to the correct website.
